<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 141.1154, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral exact mass of approximately 140.1081 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass within typical high‑resolution error is C₇H₁₂N₂O (exact mass 140.0949 Da, within ~94 ppm). This fits the required format CxHyOzX, where X is the heteroatom nitrogen (N). 

Thus, the molecular formula is: C7H12N2O.
